name: sector137
description: Sal's Crew — a Claude Code plugin. All crew agents namespaced under /sector137:

plugins.name: sector137
plugins.description: Sal's Crew — a pipeline conductor (Sal) plus the product, engineering, sales, and finance specialists. A full set of /sector137: pipeline skills route work from intake to shipped. Pairs with the sector137 MCP server. Design, brand, platform, and crew-management specialists are in the sector137-studio, -brand, -ops, and -crew plugins.

plugins.name: sector137-studio
plugins.description: Studio for Sal's Crew: Wren (UX and research), Gen wireframe prototypes, UX walkthroughs, PRDs, and synthetic personas. Bundles the sector137 studio MCP server (prototypes, PRDs, personas). Requires the core sector137 plugin.

plugins.name: sector137-crew
plugins.description: Crew management for Sal's Crew: Mira (navigator and coach) and Voss (agent architect). Bundles the sector137 crew MCP server (run a crew member, crew proposals, crew conversations, skills list). Requires the core sector137 plugin.

plugins.name: sector137-brand
plugins.description: Brand for Sal's Crew: Lyra (brand architect). Bundles the sector137 brand MCP server (brand systems, voice schemas, completeness, LLM export). Requires the core sector137 plugin.

plugins.name: sector137-ops
plugins.description: Operations for Sal's Crew: Rook (platform engineer). Bundles the sector137 ops MCP server (DORA metrics, incidents, deployments, services, initiatives). Requires the core sector137 plugin.
